title: Core: onion skinning frame range
description: Implement onion skinning support in packages/core/src/engine/onionskin.ts. Function: getOnionSkinFrames(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, currentFrame, before, after) returns an array of {frameIdx, alpha} objects for the frames to show as onion skin ghosts. Alpha = 0.25 for outermost frames, 0.5 for middle frames, based on distance from current frame. 'before' and 'after' are how many frames to include. Add unit tests.
